build: cargo build --release (LTO, codegen-units=1); zero product-code changes in plan7
refine_cap: 0.25 baseline; racers P1 (0) / P2 (1.0) vary it
round_structure: per round: one baseline sequential default run alone on the machine, then one race (P0-P3 launched concurrently, W_first = first decisive finish)
interleaving: rounds outer, cases round-robin per round (harness fixed to this order pre-campaign; recorded as a stage-2 harness fix)
pilot: 2 rounds shuffle-win only (label=pilot in the raw jsonl; excluded from all analysis)
notes: Hypothesis H (portfolio tail-trim) pre-registered in plan7.md; H1-H3 evaluated mechanically by analyze_portfolio7.py.
Solver is deterministic per (FEN, config): each racer's trajectory is fixed, so W_first variance across rounds is machine noise only.

The plan6 shuffle-win t4 bimodality (20-39 s vs 90-100 s) does NOT reproduce in sequential single-process runs of any of the 4 racer configurations: 40 sequential racer runs + 16 baseline runs all landed within ~1% of the case median wall.
